title: SciFig2Data: A Workflow for Recovering Structured Data from Scientific Figures
abstract: arXiv:2611.31787v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific measurements reported in scholarly articles are often embedded in compound figures rather than available as machine-readable data. Recovering these measurements at literature scale requires an integrated workflow for figure localization, panel decomposition, chart identification, numerical reconstruction, and experimental context association. We present \textit{SciFig2Data}, an automated, high-throughput workflow for harvesting structured experimental data from scientific PDF repositories. The system integrates multi-scale document element detection, adaptive compound figure decomposition, two-stage OCR-based semantic filtering, Swin-based chart classification, and instruction-guided multimodal large language model (MLLM) reconstruction. translated_title: SciFig2Data：一种从科学图表中恢复结构化数据的工作流
translated_abstract: 学术论文中报告的科学测量数据通常嵌入在复合图表中，而非以机器可读的数据形式提供。要在文献规模上恢复这些测量数据，需要一个涵盖图表定位、面板分解、图表类型识别、数值重建以及实验上下文关联的集成化工作流。我们提出了 SciFig2Data，这是一个自动化、高通量的工作流，用于从科学 PDF 文献库中采集结构化实验数据。该系统集成了多尺度文档元素检测、自适应复合图分解、基于 OCR 的两阶段语义过滤、基于 Swin 的图表分类，以及指令引导的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）数值重建。此外，系统还集成了目录级批量执行、缓存和结构化日志功能，以支持大规模处理。我们在两个生物医学文献语料库上演示了该工作流……
tldr: 该论文提出SciFig2Data，一个集成图表定位、复合图分解、图表识别、多模态大语言模型数值重建与上下文关联的自动化高通量工作流，能够从科学PDF文献库中大规模恢复结构化实验数据。
en_tdlr: The paper presents SciFig2Data, an automated high-throughput workflow that integrates figure localization, adaptive compound figure decomposition, chart classification, and instruction-guided MLLM reconstruction to recover structured experimental data from scientific PDF repositories at scale.
